notes.title: What’s Inside Zero Gravity Heroes?
notes.notes:
[p]If you're browsing for something fun, here's why Zero Gravity Heroes might be the perfect pick:

• 3 distinct arcade-style modes: Jetpack, Lander, and Top-down Shooter
• 90 fast-paced stages across 30 missions
• Built for short, satisfying sessions
• Family-friendly and low-pressure

If you like games with simple controls and quick challenges, Zero Gravity Heroes might be just what you're looking for.

Now available on Steam:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3627900/Zero_Gravity_Heroes/"][/dynamiclink]
If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a short review — it really helps.[/p]

notes.title: Zero Gravity Heroes Joins the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
[p]This is our very first Steam announcement — and it's a big one!

Zero Gravity Heroes is featured in the Steam Summer Sale for the first time!

What is it? A fast-paced, retro-inspired arcade game with 3 classic game modes packed into one adventure:
• Lunar lander precision
• Jetpack action
• Top-down space shooter combat

Play through 90 quick stages across 30 missions — perfect for casual players and fans of classic arcade gameplay.

Unlock hidden puzzle pieces, complete the shattered space map, and discover the final mission.

Thank you for checking out Zero Gravity Heroes — your support means everything.  
If you enjoy the game, feel free to leave a review or share it with a friend.

Available now on Steam:  
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3627900/Zero_Gravity_Heroes/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
